purpose: Research request "Gigs, hustles and fixers" (area B of the P2 game-substrate plan). Quest and quest-phase resources of the open-world work systems (street stories / gigs, fixers, NCPD scanner hustles, combat events), serialised to JSON, for fact, journal, spawn and reward analysis. Derived from game files: private, ignored by git, never packaged.

tool.name: WolvenKit CLI
tool.whyThisVersion: The same tool, version and settings as area A (quest-corpus-a-manifest.json).

commands: WolvenKit.CLI archive PATH_TO_GAME/archive/pc/content/basegame_4_gamedata.archive -l -r "[.](quest|questphase)$"   (and the same for ep1_2_gamedata.archive: path listing only, to choose what to extract)

WolvenKit.CLI extract <basegame_4_gamedata.archive> -o SCRATCH/raw -r "base.open_world.street_stories.([^.]+.)?([^.]+.)?[^.]*[.]questphase$"   (the pattern's [^.] also matches path separators, so it took every street-story phase)
WolvenKit.CLI convert serialize SCRATCH/raw   (default settings; one .json written beside each resource, then collected into json/ with the same relative paths)
WolvenKit.CLI archive <basegame_4_gamedata.archive> -l -r "[.]journal$"   (path listing, to find the cooked journal)
run: Every WolvenKit call ran under tools/memory_guard.py --limit 4 (peak about 1.4 GB).

included: base/open_world/street_stories (every gig: .quest and all phases, plus the district and framework phases)
base/open_world/fixers and bugfixing/fixers; base/open_world/phases/(fixers, cyberpsychos, autofixer_spots, open_world_content)
base/open_world/minor_activities (every phase; the .quest of six sampled hustles; post-activity templates)
base/quest/holocalls (the fixer and NCPD dispatcher holocalls and the holocall framework phases)
excluded: scenes, journal files, localisation and TweakDB (read separately, not kept)
side quests, minor quests (mq), main quests (areas A and H)
city scenes, dynamic events, mini world stories, communities, courier/sandbox activities, Phantom Liberty combat zones

examinedNotKept.what: English on-screen texts, for map-pin type labels and hustle titles
Cooked journal, for objective paths and optional flags
TweakDB reward records (QuestRewards.*), read with the Studio flat reader (no WolvenKit)
